limine-snapper-sync on Omarchy

Turns every Btrfs snapshot into a bootable Limine menu entry.

Package data synced 2026-10-20 · generated from the official Omarchy package repo

Short answer

To install limine-snapper-sync on Omarchy, open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add limine-snapper-sync. It is a 9.4 MB download (27.5 MB installed), version 1.32.1-2, licensed GPL3. Integrates Limine boot entries with Snapper snapshots. Free and open source.

On this page Install Open and use Requirements Uninstall Package facts Questions

Install limine-snapper-sync on Omarchy

This tool bridges the Snapper snapshot manager and the Limine bootloader on Btrfs systems: whenever a Snapper snapshot is created or deleted, it automatically adds or removes a matching bootable entry in Limine, complete with the right kernel files. It can also restore the system from a chosen snapshot (via rsync, file replace, or Snapper) and creates a safety backup entry after a restore so you can undo it, plus it checks bootable files for corruption.

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add limine-snapper-sync
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 1.32.1-2:
    pacman -Qi limine-snapper-sync

Open and use limine-snapper-sync

limine-snapper-sync has no window of its own: it is a command-line tool, library or system component. To see the commands it added to your PATH:

pacman -Ql limine-snapper-sync | grep /usr/bin/

limine-snapper-sync requirements and compatibility

  • Limine bootloader version 8 or newer
  • Snapper and btrfs-progs installed on a Btrfs root
  • A FAT32 boot partition, 4 GB or more recommended

Dependencies Omarchy installs for you

  • bash
  • limine
  • snapper
  • btrfs-progs
  • libnotify

Pricing and license

Free and open source. License: GPL3.

Frequently asked questions

How do I install limine-snapper-sync on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add limine-snapper-sync. The download is 9.4 MB and it takes 27.5 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is limine-snapper-sync free?

Free and open source. The package is licensed GPL3.

How do I uninstall limine-snapper-sync?

Run omarchy pkg drop limine-snapper-sync. It removes the package from your system.

What does limine-snapper-sync depend on?

The package declares 5 dependencies: bash, limine, snapper, btrfs-progs, libnotify. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is limine-snapper-sync a desktop app?

No. limine-snapper-sync has no window of its own; it is a command-line tool, library or system component.

Is limine-snapper-sync in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as limine-snapper-sync (version 1.32.1-2) in the official Omarchy package repository. Zesko makes it. Project site: https://gitlab.com/Zesko/limine-snapper-sync.
